# sentry_external_team (Resource)

Sentry External Team. Links a Sentry team to a team or channel in an external provider, such as a Slack channel for team notifications, or a GitHub or GitLab team so that CODEOWNERS team handles resolve to the Sentry team. Sentry only allows this on organizations with the `integrations-codeowners` feature enabled; otherwise the API returns `403 Forbidden`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sentry_organization_integration" "slack" {
  organization = "my-organization"

  provider_key = "slack"
  name         = "Slack Workspace"
}

data "sentry_organization_integration" "github" {
  organization = "my-organization"

  provider_key = "github"
  name         = "my-github-organization"
}

resource "sentry_team" "backend" {
  organization = "my-organization"
  name         = "Backend"
  slug         = "backend"
}

# Send the team's notifications to a Slack channel
resource "sentry_external_team" "backend_slack" {
  organization   = sentry_team.backend.organization
  team           = sentry_team.backend.slug
  provider_name  = "slack"
  external_name  = "#backend-alerts"
  integration_id = data.sentry_organization_integration.slack.id
  external_id    = "C0123456789" # optional: the Slack channel ID
}

# Resolve the "@my-github-organization/backend" CODEOWNERS handle to the Sentry team
resource "sentry_external_team" "backend_github" {
  organization   = sentry_team.backend.organization
  team           = sentry_team.backend.slug
  provider_name  = "github"
  external_name  = "@my-github-organization/backend"
  integration_id = data.sentry_organization_integration.github.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `external_name` (String) The name of the team or channel in the external provider, such as `#backend-alerts` for a Slack channel or `@my-org/backend` for a GitHub team. GitHub, GitHub Enterprise, GitLab and Cursor names must start with `@`.
- `integration_id` (String) The ID of the organization integration the mapping belongs to, for example `data.sentry_organization_integration.slack.id`.
- `organization` (String) The slug of the organization the team belongs to.
- `provider_name` (String) The external provider. Named `provider_name` because `provider` is a reserved Terraform meta-argument. One of: `github`, `github_enterprise`, `jira_server`, `slack`, `slack_staging`, `perforce`, `gitlab`, `cursor_origin`, `msteams`, `custom_scm`.
- `team` (String) The slug of the Sentry team to link.

### Optional

- `external_id` (String) The ID of the team or channel in the external provider, such as a Slack channel ID (`C0123456789`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sentry_external_team.default org-slug/team-slug/external-team-id
```
